title: One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test
abstract: arXiv:2611.19359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval [-8.3, +6.3], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, [-2.1, +18.3], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. translated_title: 一次运行还不够：在配对测试中，提醒小型Gemma 4编码智能体回顾其最近一次发现并未产生可测量的差异
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.19359v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当编码智能体的上下文空间耗尽时，其先前的发现会被截断并被遗忘。我们测试了一个简单的修复方法：自动把该智能体最近的一次发现重新放到它面前。我们事先固定了实验规则，并在Gemma 4 Developer Agent框架中使用Gemma 4 31B（QAT，4比特量化）运行了98个配对编码任务，分别带与不带这一提醒。该提醒没有产生可测量的差异：在全部98个任务中，带提醒时解决了47个，不带提醒时解决了48个（-1.0分，95%区间[-8.3, +6.3]，精确McNemar检验 p=1.0）。主要结局指标（与预注册内容存在记录在案的偏差）即前48对任务中，带记忆为29/48，不带记忆为25/48（+8.3分，[-2.1, +18.3]，p=0.22）；在该结果之后决定的50个任务扩展则指向相反方向（18/50 对 23/50，-10.0分，p=0.125），因此该效应方向未能复现。考虑到在两次完全相同的无记忆运行之间有19%的任务结果发生翻转，合并后的区间排除了大于……的危害（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 在一项预注册的98个配对编码任务测试中，自动提醒Gemma 4编码智能体其最近一次发现（以对抗上下文截断导致的遗忘）并未带来可测量的性能提升。
en_tdlr: In a preregistered paired test across 98 coding tasks, automatically reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding (to counter forgetting from context truncation) produced no measurable performance difference.
